about_short_description.short_description: MosaicVoice makes it easy for call centers to automate their Quality Assurance function

product.name: Real-Time Guidance
product.description: An AI-driven tool that provides call center agents with dynamic, relevant talking points during voice and video calls to assist customer interactions.

product.name: Intelligent Objection Management
product.description: An AI feature that detects customer objections during calls and provides agents with instant suggested responses to address those objections.

product.name: Automated Quality Assurance (QA)
product.description: A system that monitors call center compliance and quality by tracking calls, alerting managers to breaches, and prompting agents with remediation plans before calls end.

product.name: Call Summary and CRM Updates
product.description: A service that generates detailed call reports and transcripts, redacting sensitive information, and uploads them to CRM systems for record-keeping and analysis.

product.name: Analytics Dashboard
product.description: An analytics tool that provides managers with insights into call center performance and helps identify best practices based on call data.
